description: Vocci brings your voice memory into ChatGPT. Connect your Vocci account to search your ring recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, notes, and files, then turn captured conversations into useful work. Ask ChatGPT to prepare you for meetings, summarize recent sessions, find decisions and follow-ups, recover details from transcripts, create weekly digests, or turn a voice note into a product brief. Vocci reads only the context needed for your request and returns concise, source-attributed results.

defaultPrompt: Generate a daily brief from Vocci context.
Generate a list of my open follow ups from Vocci context
